records.subject: Microstructure–electrolyte solution interfacial effect
records.predicate: enhances magnitude from −1.4 to −2.5 mV K−1
records.quote: The interfacial effect of microstructure-electrolyte solution can boost ionic reactions and transport processes at the microscale.
context_quotes: It can increase the ionic thermopower and conductivity of 0.4 mol L-1 Fe(CN)64-/Fe(CN)63- electrolytes in MiTCs from -1.4 mV K-1 and 147.6 mS cm-1 to -2.5 mV K-1 and 254.2 mS cm-1, thus reaching a high Pmax/Delta T2 value of 15.4 mW m-2 K-2 at a 2 mm electrode gap and 50 mu m microstructure width, respectively, showing a significant enhancement.
records.conditions: 0.4 mol L−1 Fe(CN)6⁴−/Fe(CN)6³− electrolyte in MiTCs

records.subject: Combined thermoelectric and moist-electric generation
records.quote: Here, a two-in-one strategy is reported that combines thermoelectric and moist-electric generation mechanisms for a highly efficient flexible moist-thermoelectric generator (MTEG).
